manifestations.description: Severe cosmetic impairment; permanent scarring (keloidal) on face and legs
Low back pain (ongoing and likely to require periodic physiotherapy)
Pain described as 'agony' on movement after the accident
Embarrassment and feeling self-conscious about changed appearance when dealing with customers
Keloidal scarring on legs (described as keloidal and conspicuous)
High probability / necessity of Caesarian section in event of pregnancy (loss of opportunity for natural childbirth)

treatments_received: surgical toilet and suturing of facial and skull wounds under local anaesthesia (4th April 1981)
emergency operation under general anaesthesia involving debridgment, surgical toilet and suturing for the lower limb lacerations (4th April 1981)
removal of remaining foreign bodies over the right knee (15th April 1981)
skeletal traction to the left leg (mid-April - 26th May 1981)
physiotherapy and fitted with pressure garments (worn for more than two years)
plastic and reconstructive surgery of nose, right cheek and lower lip (admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital 6th November 1981)
multiple private cosmetic surgeries by Dr. Ian Nicholson including insertion/removal/revision of silastic implants and scar revisions (1983-1984)
physiotherapy for low back pain by Dr. William Yuen (ultrasound and short wave diathermy, October 1984)
treatments_future: further nasal surgery to clear airway obstruction and to restore the tip of the nose
periodic physiotherapy (an average course 3 times a week for about 3-4 weeks annually suggested)

losses.description: Permanent, conspicuous keloidal and facial scarring causing considerable cosmetic impairment and adversely affecting plaintiff's lifestyle
Material detrimental effect on prospects of marriage since the accident and prospectively

losses.category: Loss of ability to give natural childbirth
losses.description: Loss of the opportunity for natural childbirth; high chance/necessity of Caesarian section in event of pregnancy
